{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_numeric'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_clean = completed[completed['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Final count of completed orders after cleaning
n_completed = len(completed_clean)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA and refunded: {n_completed}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.4f}")"}
